text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interpol meeting in Algiers. "Drug trafficking is the best means of financing terrorism."
- "Terrorists" kill family of seven in Oued Slama. Security forces kill eight "terrorists".

- Armed group kill family of nine between Larba and Sidi Moussa, south of Algiers. Security forces kill some of the attackers. "Terrorists" kill 11 people, including two women, one of them nine months pregnant.
- Links between "terrorism" and drug trafficking is confirmed, with armed groups turning towards drugs for finance.
- Eleven people killed in Medkhoussa, near Tiaret; family of nine slaughtered at Larba, and "terrorists" chain together four young men then kill them in Dahmouni.
